ray-data.source_based_clarification: The preserved messages_hash_scope text is stale. Pinned production VllmEngine._prepared hashes each decoded input conversation and run_prepared passes those same conversations to LLM.chat, retaining the hash in terminal engine results. Pinned Qualification.control requires each result messages_sha256 to equal the original prepared formatter hash and carries the result field into control comparison. Thus the Ray per-call hash is an actual engine-input hash verified against the original formatter, in addition to the actual token-ID differential.
